entries.subject: Size: estimate from the JPL Horizons magnitude and an assumed albedo
entries.finding: Megaclite is drawn as a sphere of about 6.3 km diameter (radius 3.15 km), estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for body 519 (22.729 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 15.1 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured, and ignoring the phase term slightly understates it.
